title: Spacetime triple wormhole
summary: We describe a multi-neck spacetime wormhole with a simple metric tensor and a simple injective map without coordinate patching. An intra-universe, non-thin-shell, non-spherically-symmetric 3-neck spacetime wormhole is geometrically constructed by spherically inverting a 3-torus. We place the resulting Dupin hypercyclide in a synchronous reference frame. The three necks are arranged around a central point and satisfy topological and geometric spacetime wormhole definitions.
